strategy: Stay on Hard difficulty or above for extra XP multipliers, focusing on War Plans activities like Helltides and Nightmare Dungeons while maintaining fast clear speed. Constantly upgrade your ranged weapon above all other items, and use tempers/imprints on gear to manage difficulty scaling.
